items.purpose_a: CLU — Urban Line Creator — lets you design and customize public transport line maps directly in your browser.
items.modes_a: CLU can represent several transport modes, including metro, RER, suburban rail, tram, bus, cable car, river shuttle and bike services.
items.multi_q: Can I create several lines on the same map?
items.multi_a: Yes. CLU can build maps with several lines and represent shared stops and connections.
items.branches_q: Can I create branches and forks?
items.branches_a: Yes. Lines can include branches, forks, parallel branches, loops and multiple levels to build complex diagrams.
items.custom_index_q: Can I create a custom line index?
items.custom_index_a: Yes. CLU lets you create custom indices and use them on lines and in connections.
items.pictograms_q: Can I use my own pictograms?
items.pictograms_a: Yes. Custom pictograms can be used to adapt transport modes and the visual identity of the map.
items.presets_a: Yes. CLU offers presets to quickly start from an existing line, including Paris-region metro, RER, Transilien and tram lines.
items.save_a: Yes. CLU lets you save a project so you can load it and continue editing it later.
items.undo_a: Yes. CLU includes undo and redo so you can revert recent changes in the editor.
items.opensource_a_before: Yes. CLU source code is available on the
items.contribute_q: Can I contribute to the project?
items.contribute_a: Yes. You can contribute, suggest improvements or report issues from the CLU GitHub repository.
items.free_a: Yes. CLU is a free and open-source project distributed under the MIT license.
items.bug_q: I found a bug or typo. How do I report it?
items.bug_a_before: You can open an issue on the
items.bug_a_after: and describe the problem you encountered.
items.tech_a: CLU is built with Nuxt, Vue, TypeScript and PrimeVue, among other technologies.
items.browser_a: For the best experience, use a recent Chromium-based browser such as Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Vivaldi or Opera.
items.render_q: The final rendering looks wrong. What should I do?
items.render_a: If an exported render has a problem, first try a recent Chromium browser. If the issue persists, report it on the CLU GitHub repository and include steps to reproduce it.
items.mobile_q: Does the site work on mobile?
items.mobile_a: CLU is mainly designed for desktop use. A sufficiently large screen is recommended for comfortable editing.
items.origin_a: CLU is based on SlamaFR's open-source BULB project, itself derived from notKamui's Nightrunner. CLU continues that foundation with many changes and additional features.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: CLU (Urban Line Creator) is a tool for creating public transport line maps.
privacy.local_text: CLU mainly runs directly in your browser. Some data required for the application to work, including preferences and locally saved projects, may be stored in your browser storage.
privacy.analytics_text_1: CLU uses Google Analytics to measure site usage and better understand its audience. This service may collect information about site usage, such as pages viewed, interactions, device type and approximate geographic information.
privacy.analytics_text_2: This information helps us analyze CLU traffic and improve the service.
privacy.adsense_text_1: CLU uses or may use Google AdSense to display advertisements.
privacy.adsense_text_2: Google and its partners may use cookies or similar technologies to display, measure and personalize ads, depending on the user's consent choices and applicable regulations.
privacy.consent_text_1: For affected users, particularly in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland, CLU uses Google's consent management platform (CMP).
privacy.consent_text_2: This platform lets users accept, refuse or manage choices related to data use and advertising technologies.
privacy.google_text: To learn more about how Google uses information from sites or apps that use its services, see the privacy information provided by Google.
privacy.google_link: How Google uses information from sites that use its services
privacy.manage_text: Data stored locally by CLU can be deleted by clearing the site's data from your browser settings.
privacy.changes_text: This privacy policy may be updated to reflect changes to CLU, the services used or applicable requirements.
